notes: Written before any scored round. Reasoning from four probe evaluations I ran while debugging the simulator (a V of 20 degrees held 7 of 8 objects; flat pads lost small and thin parts) and from the stress formula: the servo limit of 8 N needs w*t^2/L >= about 2.4 mm^2 (units mm), so a 2 to 3 mm plate is enough and plastic stays small. Round 1 spreads over pad width, V angle and length to see which matter.
